title: Catch a Bad Sensor
story: ION: The second assembly wing needs production-grade Python. Restore the machine, then inspect its diagnostics with O.
objective: Define SensorFault as a subclass of ValueError, and Sensor(low, high). read(value) returns value when low <= value <= high. Otherwise raise exactly SensorFault. Inputs are finite numbers and low <= high. Valid readings after a fault must still work.
lesson: A domain-specific exception lets callers distinguish a sensor fault from unrelated errors. Validate both inclusive limits.
